scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. 60 boards from six live Deity 6p Continents Online Culture-seat games of 2026-11-18/19 (civvis-20261118T171747Z, -T210202Z and -T220255Z, 0 visitors at t180; -T122047Z, 532 of 556 at t188; -T092341Z and civvis-20261119T024425Z, both won): open policy windows from Drama and Poetry to t160, at most ten a game, each the run's events.jsonl cut right after that turn's first state row with an open window and replayed at that turn.
